rooms.1: Endless golden desert: rolling dunes under a blazing sun in a deep blue sky, a small pyramid far away on the horizon, a few rocks in the foreground.
rooms.2: Golden desert dunes under a blazing sun; in the foreground a bleached camel skull and scattered bones half-buried in the sand.
rooms.3: Flat open desert of hot sand with a few tufts of dry scrub and scattered rocks, a low dune behind, the sun high overhead. The middle of the foreground is open empty sand.
rooms.4: A great sandstone pyramid fills the centre with a dark square entrance at its base, rolling dunes either side, scattered rocks, a blazing sun in a deep blue sky, and a weathered wooden sign post (blank, no writing) planted in the sand.
rooms.5: View from the bottom of a deep hole freshly dug in the desert sand, looking at the sandy walls rising steeply to a square of blue sky above; at the bottom, a small patch of ancient stone wall is exposed in the sand.
rooms.6: A rough-hewn rocky entranceway inside a pyramid: jagged stone walls, a flickering torch on the left wall, a dark rectangular doorway in the far wall, a dusty floor. The right half of the floor is open and clear.
rooms.7: Looking down from inside an open golden sarcophagus, its gilded rim framing the view, into a dark shaft where worn stone stairs descend into blackness.
rooms.8: A torchlit ancient Egyptian burial chamber: sandstone block walls, a painted frieze of red hieroglyphs above a gold band on the far wall, torches burning on either side wall, a dusty floor. The centre of the room is open floor.
rooms.9: A very long, narrow stone passageway inside a pyramid, receding into the distance to a small dim end, faint warm light.
rooms.10: A small, cramped hidden alcove of dark rough stone inside a pyramid, low ceiling, dusty bare floor, dim light.
rooms.11: A very tall, narrow stone chamber inside a pyramid, its ceiling lost high in darkness, bare floor, dim light from above.
rooms.12: An ancient Egyptian dining hall: sandstone walls, two torches on the far wall flanking a red tapestry with a gold fringe. The hall is completely EMPTY of furniture: no table, no chairs, no benches, just a wide bare stone floor.
rooms.13: A stone hallway inside a pyramid ending in a dark arched doorway in the far wall, dusty floor, torchlight.
rooms.14: A round altar room inside a pyramid: a circular chamber ringed by pale stone columns, two dark doorways between the columns, a dusty floor with open space in the centre.
rooms.15: A chamber whose walls are covered floor to ceiling with painted Egyptian hieroglyphs in dark brown and red on pale stone, gold bands along the top and bottom of the far wall.
rooms.16: An ancient Egyptian sitting room: sandstone walls, a low red couch against the left wall, a torch on the right wall, the centre of the far wall bare.
rooms.17: A low, cramped tunnel of dark stone sloping upward into darkness, a gritty floor, barely enough room to crawl.
rooms.18: A circular cavern whose whole floor is a giant stone turntable with radial seams around a central hub, rough cavern walls, curved golden arrows painted on the walls suggesting rotation.
rooms.19: A gloomy stone prison cell seen through rusty iron bars in the foreground, damp dark walls, a dusty floor.
rooms.20: A narrow rock ledge high on the wall of a deep dark shaft, faint light falling from a hole in the ceiling, and far below a glowing green-yellow pool of acid.
rooms.21: A grand pharaoh's throne room: an empty golden throne against the far wall beneath a painted mural of Egyptian figures, a red rug before it, a heavy iron chain hanging from the ceiling, a small wooden chest by the right wall.
rooms.22: A treasure room inside a pyramid with walls of gleaming gold blocks, a torch on the left wall, an open stone floor.
rooms.23: View from the very apex of a great pyramid looking down its stepped stone slope over endless desert to the horizon, a tiny green oasis far away, blazing sun in a deep blue sky.
rooms.24: A desert oasis: a still blue pool of water surrounded by date palms and a little green grass, golden dunes beyond, a blazing sun.
rooms.25: A plain, dim stone passage inside a pyramid receding to a dark end.
rooms.26: An ancient Egyptian dressing room: a tall gold-framed mirror on the far wall, a wooden rack hung with colourful robes on the left, a small chest of clothes on the right.
rooms.27: Death: a grinning human skull floating in darkness, lit by a hellish red glow, ominous and final.

items.10: A weathered wooden pole sticking up out of a small mound of sand.
items.14: A shallow pool of bubbling, glowing green liquid, seen from slightly above.
items.20: A closed golden Egyptian sarcophagus with a painted pharaoh face on its lid.
items.22: An open golden Egyptian sarcophagus, its lid leaning against its side, empty and dark inside.
items.27: A small desert nomad in flowing white robes and headscarf, standing.
items.29: A fearsome Egyptian mummy standing, full body, facing the viewer, glowing red eyes, wrapped in old bandages.
items.32: An enraged Egyptian mummy, full body, arms raised and reaching forward, glowing yellow eyes, wrapped in old bandages.
items.33: An Egyptian mummy lying asleep on its back on the floor, full body seen from the side, wrapped in old bandages.
items.44: An open wooden treasure coffer bound with gold, overflowing with gold coins and jewels.
items.47: A wooden chopping block with a heavy axe buried in it.
items.48: A human skull resting on its own.
items.49: A small plain wooden box with a lid.
items.53: A rusty iron bar hanging straight down, as if protruding from a ceiling above (the top edge cut off).
items.54: A decapitated human skeleton lying flat on its back, seen from the side. It has NO head and NO skull at all: the spine ends in a clean break at the neck.
items.56: A stone fireplace with a mantel, its hearth empty and dark, ashes inside.
items.58: A tall wooden ladder standing upright.
items.60: A long low ancient Egyptian dining table set with gold goblets and a plate.
items.63: A giant oyster shell, slightly open, pearly grey.
items.66: A stone altar with dark blood stains running down its sides.
items.69: Two plump, contented grey rats sitting quietly.
items.71: A pack of six starving, scrawny grey rats with red eyes, scattered and hungry.
items.73: A hissing cobra reared up with its hood spread, coiled at the base.
items.76: The skeleton of a dead explorer in a pith helmet and ragged khaki clothes, chained by the wrists to a wall (the wall itself not shown, just the hanging chains).
items.77: A pile of rubbish: broken pottery, rags, dust and rubble.
items.78: A closed heavy iron portal door set in a stone frame.
items.79: An open stone portal frame with darkness beyond.
items.80: A huge purple worm rearing up, its round mouth ringed with teeth.
items.85: A rope hanging straight down, as if from a ceiling above (the top edge cut off).
items.86: An iron statue of a pharaoh seated, hands on knees, as if on a throne (the throne itself not shown), stern face with red jewel eyes.
items.92: A stone spiral staircase winding upward.
items.94: An iron statue of a pharaoh standing upright, arms at its sides, red jewel eyes.
items.95: An iron statue of a pharaoh striding forward menacingly, one arm reaching out, red jewel eyes glowing.
items.96: A puddle of melted iron, still glowing orange at the edges.
items.98: An open stone window with bright sky beyond.
items.99: A closed wooden treasure coffer bound with gold bands and a lock.
items.100: A small stone window blocked by heavy iron bars, bright sky beyond.
